faq.a: Partly. 6 of the 8 versions of MiniMax in the OpenRouter catalog publish open weights, and 2 are served over APIs only. The family's repositories on Hugging Face carry a custom licence set out on each model card.
Through the OpenRouter catalog, MiniMax costs from $0.2 to $0.55 per million input tokens and from $0.84 to $2.2 per million output tokens, depending on the version. The cheapest is MiniMax M2.7.
MiniMax M3 is the newest version in the OpenRouter catalog, added on 2026-05-31. The newest dated model line on MiniMax's own site is MiniMax Music 3.0, dated 2026-08-13.
faq.q: What is the newest MiniMax model?

faq.a: MiniMax versions accept image, text and video as input and produce text. 6 of the 8 versions support reasoning, and context windows run from 65,536 to 1,048,576 tokens.
MiniMax is developed by MiniMax. MiniMax is a startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in Shanghai, China.

MiniMax's own site names these ways to use its models: API, Coding Plan, HuggingFace, GitHub, https://hailuoai.video/zh-Intl/tools/minimax-h3 and MiniMax Audio. In the OpenRouter catalog, 17 providers serve it.

paragraphs: MiniMax is a family of AI models from the developer MiniMax, offered through the MiniMax API. The pages describe text models, video models, speech models, image generation, and music generation. MiniMax says the text models support multilingual programming, Agent workflows and complex task scenarios, and the MiniMax-M3 model is described as an Agentic Model with exceptional Tool Use capabilities. MiniMax H3 is described as a new-generation open general-purpose multimodal video model, and MiniMax's video models, MiniMax H3 and MiniMax H3 Max, enable efficient video content creation.

The text line includes MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview, MiniMax-M3, MiniMax-M2.7, MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed, MiniMax-M2.5, MiniMax-M2.5-highspeed, MiniMax-M2.1, MiniMax-M2.1-highspeed and MiniMax-M2. MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview and MiniMax-M3 have a 1,000,000 context window, and MiniMax-M2.7 has 204,800. MiniMax says MiniMax-M2 ranks Top-1 among open-source models and Top-5 among all models. Other lines include MiniMax ASR for speech-to-text, MiniMax's speech models for voice cloning, MiniMax Music 3, and MiniMax H3-Base, which jointly generates 768p video and synchronized stereo audio.

MiniMax offers the models through the MiniMax API, with an Anthropic SDK, an OpenAI SDK and an AI SDK, and through M Plan and MiniMax Code. MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview is available only through M Plan and MiniMax Code for now. MiniMax also documents running and self-hosting MiniMax open models, including MiniMax-M3, MiniMax-M2.7, MiniMax Music 3 and MiniMax H3, locally or on a server.

price_limits.summary: Across the 8 versions, input prices run from $0.2 to $0.55 per million tokens and output prices from $0.84 to $2.2. MiniMax M2.7 is the cheapest, at $0.21 per million input tokens and $0.84 per million output tokens. MiniMax M3 has the largest context window, 1,048,576 tokens.

family_reading.text: MiniMax spans eight catalog versions, from MiniMax-01 in January 2025 to MiniMax M3 in May 2026. Across the family, 6 of 8 versions support reasoning and 6 of 8 publish open weights, so open and closed releases sit side by side. Context windows run from 65536 to 1048576 tokens, and the line takes image, text and video input while returning text only. The newest versions are cheap for their size, with M3 at $0.3 per million input and $1.2 output and a 512000 token output ceiling, while M1 costs more at $0.55 input and $2.2 output. This suits long document, video and image work where low cost per token matters. Limits: M2-her has a 65536 token window and only 2048 output tokens, and M1 caps output at 40000 tokens despite its million token context.
